question: Should Semaphore project discovery fail closed when a provider response supplies a malformed or authority-changing pagination link, rather than silently ending pagination as before?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible token-boundary hardening, but it intentionally changes runtime failure behavior for existing Semaphore users and needs an explicit maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Fail closed on unsafe links
options.body: Accept the PR's security posture, provided a redacted live provider trace confirms normal same-origin pagination still works.

options.title: Retain tolerant pagination
options.body: Treat unsafe next links as the end of pagination and document the residual discovery tradeoff instead of returning an error.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on unsafe links
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's security posture, provided a redacted live provider trace confirms normal same-origin pagination still works.
